item.title: Brand names sold as advertising keywords on Amazon: update
item.description:
Kent RO Systems Ltd. v. Amazon Seller Services Pvt. Ltd. (CS(COMM) 1145/2026) (Delhi High Court)

The question: Whether Amazon infringes the well-known mark KENT by letting sellers bid on it as a keyword in its sponsored-products ads, and whether Amazon can claim intermediary safe harbour.

Where it stands: On 16 October Justice Tejas Karia issued summons on Kent's application for an ad interim injunction; Amazon accepted notice. No interim relief has been granted. Amazon's reply is due within three weeks and its written statement within 30 days.
